```{r inclass-analysis}
# function to compute tests
test_fn <- function(.df){
  t_test(.df, 
         formula = level ~ group,
         order = c('ASD', 'TD'),
         alternative = 'two-sided',
         var.equal = F)
}

ttests_out <- biomarker_clean %>%
  # drop ADOS score
  select(-ados) %>%
  # arrange in long format
  pivot_longer(-group, 
               names_to = 'protein', 
               values_to = 'level') %>%
  # nest by protein
  nest(data = c(level, group)) %>% 
  # compute t tests
  mutate(ttest = map(data, test_fn)) %>%
  unnest(ttest) %>%
  # sort by p-value
  arrange(p_value) %>%
  # multiple testing correction
  mutate(m = n(),
         hm = log(m) + 1/(2*m) - digamma(1),
         rank = row_number(),
         p.adj = m*hm*p_value/rank)

# select significant proteins
proteins_s1 <- ttests_out %>%
  slice_min(p.adj, n = 10) %>%
  pull(protein)

## RANDOM FOREST
##################

# store predictors and response separately
predictors <- biomarker_clean %>%
  select(-c(group, ados))

response <- biomarker_clean %>% pull(group) %>% factor()

# fit RF
set.seed(101422)
rf_out <- randomForest(x = predictors, 
                       y = response, 
                       ntree = 1000, 
                       importance = T)

# check errors
rf_out$confusion

# compute importance scores
proteins_s2 <- rf_out$importance %>% 
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(protein = rownames(rf_out$importance)) %>%
  slice_max(MeanDecreaseGini, n = 10) %>%
  pull(protein)

## LOGISTIC REGRESSION
#######################

# select subset of interest
proteins_sstar <- intersect(proteins_s1, proteins_s2)

biomarker_sstar <- biomarker_clean %>%
  select(group, any_of(proteins_sstar)) %>%
  mutate(class = (group == 'ASD')) %>%
  select(-group)

biomarker_sstar

# partition into training and test set
set.seed(101422)
biomarker_split <- biomarker_sstar %>%
  initial_split(prop = 0.8)

# fit logistic regression model to training set
fit <- glm(class ~ ., 
           data = training(biomarker_split), 
           family = 'binomial')

# evaluate errors on test set
class_metrics <- metric_set(sensitivity, 
                            specificity, 
                            accuracy,
                            roc_auc)



original_metrics <- testing(biomarker_split) %>%
  add_predictions(fit, type = 'response') %>% 
  mutate(estimate = factor(pred >0.5, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)),
         truth = factor(class, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE))) %>%
  class_metrics(estimate = estimate,
              truth = truth, pred,
              event_level = 'second')

biomarker_clean

```

```{r fuzzy}
fuzzy_panel <- function(n, ttests, rf, thresh = 0.25){
  mem <- function(rank) pmax(0, 1 - (rank - 1) / (2 * n))

  t_rank <- ttests |>
    arrange(p.adj) |>
    transmute(protein, m_t = mem(row_number()))

  r_rank <- rf$importance |>
    as_tibble(rownames = "protein") |>
    arrange(desc(MeanDecreaseGini)) |>
    transmute(protein, m_r = mem(row_number()))

  inner_join(t_rank, r_rank, by = "protein") |>
    mutate(m = pmin(m_t, m_r)) |>
    filter(m >= thresh) |>
    pull(protein)
}
```

get_train_panels <- function(n){
  ttest_proteins <- train.ttests_out |> slice_min(p.adj, n=n) |> pull(protein)
  rf_proteins <- train.rf_out$importance |> as_tibble() |>
  mutate(protein = rownames(train.rf_out$importance)) |> slice_max(MeanDecreaseGini, n = n) |> pull(protein)
  
  
  fuzzy <- fuzzy_panel(n, train.ttests_out, train.rf_out)
  hard <- intersect(ttest_proteins, rf_proteins)
  list(hard = hard, fuzzy = fuzzy)
}



evaluate <- function(panel){
  
  if(length(panel) == 0) return(NULL) # Just in case panel has no proteins
  
  fit <- glm(class ~., data = biomarker_train |> mutate(class = (group == "ASD")) |> select(class, all_of(panel)), family = 'binomial')
  
  class_metrics <- metric_set(sensitivity, 
                            specificity, 
                            accuracy,
                            roc_auc)
  
  biomarker_test |> 
    add_predictions(fit, type = 'response') |>
    mutate(estimate = factor(pred > 0.5, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)),
           class = (group == "ASD"),
           truth = factor(class, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE))) |>
    class_metrics(estimate = estimate, truth = truth, pred, event_level = 'second')
}



  
get_full_panels <- function(n){
  ttest_proteins <- ttests_out |> slice_min(p.adj, n=n) |> pull(protein)
  rf_proteins <- rf_out$importance |> as_tibble() |>
  mutate(protein = rownames(rf_out$importance)) |> slice_max(MeanDecreaseGini, n = n) |> pull(protein)
  
  fuzzy <- fuzzy_panel(n, ttests_out, rf_out)
  hard <- intersect(ttest_proteins, rf_proteins)
  list(hard = hard, fuzzy = fuzzy)
}




list_ns <- c(10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35)

Q3.results <- map(list_ns, function(n){
  # get the panel of n proteins 
  p <- get_train_panels(n)
  
  # iterate through the panels by type
  map(names(p), function(type){
    metrics <- evaluate(p[[type]])
    proteins <- p[[type]]
    # if empty then return NULL
    if (is.null(metrics)) return (NULL)
    
    # How many proteins captured by fuzzy or hard intersect
    length <- length(p[[type]])
    
    # Add descriptive columns to differentiate metrics
    metrics |>
      mutate(type = type, n = n, length = length, panel = list(proteins)) 
  }) |> list_rbind() 
}) |> list_rbind() # combine each list by rows into one data frame

    length <- length(p[[type]])
    
    # Add descriptive columns to differentiate metrics
    metrics |>
      mutate(type = type, n = n, length = length, panel = list(proteins)) 
  }) |> list_rbind() 
}) |> list_rbind() # combine each list by rows into one data frame

```{r}
#Model Generator function used later for testing several combinations of parameters
modelGenerators <- function(num1, num2, intersection = FALSE){
  proteins_s1 <- ttests_out %>%
    slice_min(p.adj, n = num1) %>%
    pull(protein)
  # compute importance scores
  proteins_s2 <- rf_out$importance %>% 
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(protein = rownames(rf_out$importance)) %>%
    slice_max(MeanDecreaseGini, n = num2) %>%
    pull(protein)
  ## LOGISTIC REGRESSION
  #######################
  
  # select subset of interest
  proteins_hard <- intersect(proteins_s1, proteins_s2)
  proteins_fuzzy <- fuzzy_panel(num1, ttests_out, rf_out)
  if (intersection){
    proteins <- fuzzy_panel(num1, ttests_out, rf_out)
  }
  else{
    proteins <- intersect(proteins_s1, proteins_s2)
  }
  
  biomarker_sstar <- training(biomarker_split) %>%
    select(group, any_of(proteins)) %>%
    mutate(class = (group == 'ASD')) %>%
    select(-group)
  
  # fit logistic regression model to training set
  fit <- glm(class ~ ., 
             data = biomarker_sstar, 
             family = 'binomial')
  
  testing_data <- testing(biomarker_split) %>%
    mutate(class = (group == 'ASD'))
  

  # evaluate errors on test set
  class_metrics <- metric_set(sensitivity, 
                              specificity, 
                              accuracy,
                              roc_auc)
  
  output_results <- testing_data %>%
    add_predictions(fit, type = 'response') %>% 
    mutate(estimate = factor(pred >0.5, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)),
           truth = factor(class, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE))) %>%
    class_metrics(estimate = estimate,
                             truth = truth, pred,
                             event_level = 'second')
  
  actual <- testing_data$group
  predicted <- predict(fit, newdata = testing_data, type = 'response')
  roc_obj <- roc(actual, predicted, levels = c("TD", "ASD"))
  
  plot(roc_obj, 
     main = paste('ROC Curve:',  num1, num2, intersection, sep = ' '), 
     col = '#1c7ed6', 
     lwd = 3, 
     print.auc = TRUE,
     legacy.axes = TRUE)
  
  abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = 'darkgray')
  
  output_results$proteins_s1 <- c(num1, num1, num1, num1)
  output_results$proteins_s2 <- c(num2, num2, num2, num2)
  output_results$total_proteins <- c(length(proteins), length(proteins), length(proteins), length(proteins))
  if (intersection){
    output_results$intersection <- c('Fuzzy','Fuzzy','Fuzzy','Fuzzy')
  }
  else{
    output_results$intersection <- c('Hard','Hard','Hard','Hard')
  }
  return(output_results)
}
```

```{r}
#Testing different combinations of number of proteins and intersection type
num1 <- c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40)
num2 <- c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40)
finalResults <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 7, nrow = 0))
colnames(finalResults) <- c('.metric', '.estimator', '.estimate', 'proteins_s1', 'proteins_s2', 'total_proteins', 'intersection')
for (i in num1){
  for (j in num2){
    finalResults <- rbind(finalResults, modelGenerators(i, j, FALSE))
    finalResults <- rbind(finalResults, modelGenerators(i, j, TRUE))
  }
}
# write.csv(finalResults, file = '../data/Q3v2_results.csv')

finalResults
```
```{r}
#Comparisons of AUC to different factors
#Shows that number of proteins isn't too important for AUC
#Generally models perform best with a decent amount of proteins but not too many proteins
plot(finalResults[finalResults$intersection != 'Fuzzy' &  finalResults$.metric == 'roc_auc',]$.estimate ~ finalResults[finalResults$intersection != 'Fuzzy' &  finalResults$.metric == 'roc_auc',]$total_proteins,
     main = 'Comparing AUC Values to Protein Count for Hard Intersection', ylab = 'AUC', xlab = 'Protein Count')
finalResults[finalResults$intersection != 'Fuzzy' & finalResults$.metric == 'roc_auc',]$total_proteins

plot(finalResults[finalResults$intersection != 'Hard' &  finalResults$.metric == 'roc_auc',]$.estimate ~ finalResults[finalResults$intersection != 'Hard' &  finalResults$.metric == 'roc_auc',]$total_proteins,
     main = 'Comparing AUC Values to Protein Count for Fuzzy Intersection', ylab = 'AUC', xlab = 'Protein Count')

finalResults[finalResults$intersection != 'Hard' & finalResults$.metric == 'roc_auc',]$total_proteins
#Shows that Fuzzy intersection on average performs worse in general
boxplot(finalResults[finalResults$.metric == 'roc_auc',]$.estimate ~ finalResults[finalResults$.metric == 'roc_auc',]$intersection,
        main = 'Comparing AUC Values to Intersection Type', ylab = 'AUC', xlab = 'Intersection Types')
```
